meta.name: get-available-resources
meta.description: Detect host inventory and effective CPU, memory, disk, scheduler, container, and accelerator limits when a user asks for resource-aware planning or before a clearly resource-sensitive local workload. Produces a redacted JSON snapshot and conservative planning helpers without stress tests or assuming visible host hardware is usable.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检测主机资源并生成可用资源快照
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在运行资源敏感任务前了解可用CPU、内存和磁盘限制
copy.tagline_en: Detect host resources and generate a usable resource snapshot
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to know available CPU, memory, and disk limits before running resource-sensitive tasks

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会在执行计算密集型任务前自动检测系统资源（CPU、GPU、内存、磁盘），生成一个 JSON 文件，包含资源数据和策略建议，帮助决定是否使用并行处理、GPU 加速或内存优化方案。
howto.when: 当用户提出计算密集型任务（如分析大型数据集、训练模型、并行处理文件）时，Claude 会在开始前自动触发资源检测。

say.text: 帮我分析这个50GB的基因组数据。
用这些数据训练一个神经网络。
say.note: Claude 会检测 GPU 可用性并推荐合适的后端。
Claude 会检测 CPU 核心数并建议最佳并行数。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude automatically detects system resources (CPU, GPU, memory, disk) before computationally intensive tasks, generates a JSON file with resource data and strategic recommendations to decide whether to use parallel processing, GPU acceleration, or memory-efficient strategies.
howto.when_en: When the user proposes a computationally intensive task (e.g., analyzing large datasets, training models, processing files in parallel), Claude triggers resource detection before starting.

say_en.text: Help me analyze this 50GB genomics dataset.
say_en.note: Claude will first detect resources, then decide if Dask etc. is needed.

say_en.text: Train a neural network on this data.
say_en.note: Claude will detect GPU availability and recommend a backend.
Claude will detect CPU cores and suggest optimal worker count.
